服务响应异常，请确认服务仍在运行。: Unexpected response. Check that the local service is still running.
请求参数无效，请检查后重试。: Invalid request. Check the options and try again.
只加载你正在浏览的数据。: Load only the data you need.
只读浏览 · 原始文件不会被修改: Read-only · Your source file stays unchanged
本地优先 · 跨平台 · 无外部网页资源: Local-first · Cross-platform · No external web assets
点击一行查看详情: Click a row to inspect its values
把复杂的数据，变得清晰。: A clearer view of your data.
从文件结构到具体内容，让 Parquet 不再是黑盒。: From schema to values, make your Parquet files easy to understand.
轻松打开，按需浏览，大文件也能从容探索。: Open, browse, and explore large files on demand.
字段类型、嵌套层级与空值属性，清晰呈现。: Inspect field types, nested structures, and nullability.
行组定位与分页读取，让内存留给真正有用的数据。: Row-group navigation and paging keep reads focused.
电脑本地运行，浏览器即开即用，支持可信局域网访问。: Run locally on your computer and access it over a trusted LAN.
按需读取，轻量浏览: Read on demand, browse with ease
跳转到页，输入后按回车: Enter a page number and press Enter
输入页码，按回车跳转: Enter a page number to jump
筛选 / 排序可能扫描文件 · 受资源限制保护: Filters and sorting may scan the file · Resource limits apply
行组定位读取 · 双击单元格也可查看详情: Row-group-aware reads · Click a cell to inspect
正在查询，超时将自动停止…: Running query… It will stop at the time limit.
文件中没有数据行: This file has no data rows
试试调整筛选条件，或者重置筛选。: Adjust your filters or reset them to try again.
仍然可以在“文件结构”中查看字段。: You can still inspect the fields in the Schema tab.
超长单元格仅展示有限预览，源文件未改变: Long cells show bounded previews. The source file is unchanged.
点击切换升序、降序、取消排序: Click to cycle through ascending, descending, and no sort
连接已断开，请确认本机服务仍在运行。: Connection lost. Check that the local service is still running.
直接来自 Parquet 页脚，无需扫描数据。null 表示文件未记录对应统计信: Read directly from the Parquet footer without scanning data. null means no statistic was recorded; min / max apply to each row group.
这是一个嵌套字段。可在左侧展开查看子字段；嵌套叶子的统计不直接等同于父字段统计，: This is a nested field. Inspect its children in the tree. Leaf statistics do not describe the parent directly, so null counts are not combined here.
行组是 Parquet 的独立读取单元。点击“浏览数据”可直接跳转到该组。: Row groups are independent read units. Choose Browse data to jump to a group.
合适的行组大小有助于并行读取与筛选跳过。: Appropriate row-group sizes help parallel reads and filter pruning.
文件没有行组: This file has no row groups
最多展示 50 项，每项最多 4,096 字符；内部 Arrow schema: Up to 50 entries and 4,096 characters per entry. Internal Arrow schema metadata is hidden.
该文件没有可展示的自定义元数据。: This file has no custom metadata to display.
值较长，仅显示截断预览；导出和复制也只包含此预览。: This value is truncated. Exports and copied data also contain this preview only.
已复制当前行 JSON（超长值为预览）: Row copied as JSON (long values are previews)
已导出当前页 {0} 行{1}；null 输出为空单元格: Exported {0} rows{1}; null values become empty cells
文件超过上传限制，请使用本机路径打开: File exceeds the upload limit. Open it by local path instead.
请等待当前上传完成: Wait for the current upload to finish
传输完成，正在读取文件结构…: Upload complete. Reading the file schema…
上传中断，请检查连接后重试: Upload interrupted. Check the connection and try again.
Parquet Lens · 看清每一层数据: Parquet Lens · See every layer of your data
该文件没有可筛选的字段: This file has no fields to filter
最多添加 12 个条件: You can add up to 12 conditions
最多同时展示 80 个字段: You can display up to 80 fields at a time
请输入 1–{0} 之间的页码: Enter a page number between 1 and {0}
一次打开一个文件，已选择第一个: Opening one file at a time; the first file was selected
点击选择，或拖拽文件到这里: Choose a file or drop it here
直接读取本机文件路径: Open a local file by path
无需上传或复制文件，适合 GB 级大文件。路径位于运行服务的电脑上。: Read without uploading or copying, ideal for GB-scale files. The path must be on the computer running the service.
数据由你运行的服务处理，不发送到第三方。: Data is processed by your service, never sent to third parties.
只读取选中的字段。最多 80 个，宽表建议按需选择。: Only selected columns are read. Choose up to 80; select fewer for wide tables.
所有条件同时满足（AND）。筛选值按字段类型匹配。: All conditions must match (AND). Values are matched against each field's type.
筛选可能扫描文件内容；超时会自动停止。不会修改源文件。: Filters may scan the file. Queries stop at the time limit. The source file is unchanged.
本机大文件可以使用路径直接打开，省去传输等待。: For large local files, open by path to skip the upload.
请使用启动时显示的完整访问链接打开软件。: Open the app using the complete access link printed at startup.
本机路径只允许在运行服务的电脑上打开；其他设备请上传文件。: Local paths can only be opened on the computer running the service. Upload a file from other devices.
文件超过上传大小限制，请使用本机路径直接打开。: File exceeds the upload limit. Open it by local path instead.
当前页内容过大，请减少每页行数或所选字段。: This page is too large. Reduce the page size or select fewer columns.
文件已被移动或删除，请重新打开。: The file was moved or deleted. Open it again.
文件已发生变化，请关闭后重新打开。: The file changed. Close it and open it again.
文件含有重名或仅大小写不同的顶层字段，暂不支持，请先重命名字段。: Duplicate top-level field names, including case-only differences, are not supported. Rename them first.
无法打开文件：请检查权限，并确认文件是完整、未加密的 Parquet 文件。: Unable to open the file. Check permissions and make sure it is a complete, unencrypted Parquet file.
最多同时打开 24 个文件，请先关闭不需要的文件。: Up to 24 files can be open at once. Close an unused file first.
文件会话不存在，请重新打开。: File session not found. Open the file again.
请至少选择一个字段，且不能重复。: Select at least one field, without duplicates.
所选字段不存在。: A selected field does not exist.
正在处理其他查询，请稍后重试。: Other queries are running. Try again shortly.
查询超过时间限制，已停止。请减少筛选范围或取消排序。: Query stopped at the time limit. Narrow the filters or remove sorting.
查询达到资源限制。请减少所选字段、缩小范围或取消排序。: Query reached its resource limit. Select fewer columns, narrow the filters, or remove sorting.
读取失败，请检查筛选值是否匹配字段类型，或重新打开文件。: Read failed. Check that filter values match the field types, or open the file again.
界面语言加载失败，请刷新重试。: Could not load the interface language. Refresh to try again.
